items.question: How is the hidden-test share rounded when it doesn't divide the bounty evenly?
items.ticket: record a partial release of the configured hidden-test share (default 75%)
items.chose: Rounds the hidden-test amount down with integer BigInt division, and the UAT release gets the leftover.
items.instead: Round to nearest, or round the hidden-test share up.

items.question: What happens when UAT is approved before the hidden tests have passed?
items.chose: Throws an Error and records nothing.
items.instead: Release the whole bounty, or ignore the event and return the current state.

items.question: What happens when UAT is approved after the hidden tests failed?
items.chose: Throws, because no hidden-tests release exists, and saves nothing.
items.instead: Ignore the event quietly, or release the full bounty on UAT.

items.question: What does a failed hidden-test run do to the stored state?
items.chose: Returns a snapshot of the current state and never calls store.set, so no failure is recorded.
items.instead: Persist a failed marker, or reject so the failure is visible to the caller.

items.question: What happens to a repeated or duplicate event of an already-released kind?
items.chose: Returns the current state without saving. Duplicates are detected by whether a release of that kind exists, and the event id is ignored.
items.instead: Track processed event ids, or throw on a duplicate.

items.question: Can hidden tests pass again after a failed run, or after a pass has already been recorded?
items.chose: A pass after a failure still releases, because failures leave no trace. A pass after UAT is a no-op, since the hidden-tests release already exists.
items.instead: Make a failed run final and lock the task, or reject a pass that arrives after UAT.

items.question: What happens when the bounty is 0?
items.chose: Accepts it, reports status "pro bono", and still records zero-amount releases.
items.instead: Reject a zero bounty, or skip recording any release and keep the status "locked".

items.question: What counts as a valid bounty and share, and what happens when they are invalid?
items.chose: Throws RangeError unless the bounty is a non-negative safe integer and the share is an integer from 0 to 10000 bps. The checks run when the handler is created.
items.instead: Allow fractional amounts or a percentage share, clamp out-of-range values, or fail only when an event is handled.

items.question: What unit and precision does the configured share use?
items.chose: Reads the share as integer basis points (default 7500), taken from task.hiddenTestShareBps.
items.instead: Use a fractional or percent value such as 0.75 or 75.

items.question: How much does the UAT approval release?
items.chose: Releases bounty minus the sum of all prior releases, recomputed at approval time.

items.question: Are events processed one at a time, and what happens when the store fails?
items.chose: Queues events per handler so they run serially. A store failure rejects that call, the queue keeps going, and a retry works because state is saved only after set succeeds. Serialization covers only a single handler instance.
items.instead: Process events concurrently, or rely on store-level locking or compare-and-set.

items.question: What happens for an unknown event kind?
items.chose: Throws an Error naming the unknown kind.
items.instead: Ignore it and return the current state.
